## Change

Describe the concrete problem and resulting behavior. Target the working lab branch linked in README.

## Evidence and validation

Give the relevant test commands and results. For research, link the round, frozen specification/code commit,
input hashes, compact artifacts and 1x/2x/3x cost results. Preserve a NULL verdict and the exact tested scope.

## Limits and dependencies

Name unrun checks, missing data, prerequisite PRs and remaining questions. Distinguish historical, replay and
genuinely new on-time evidence. Keep current method status in the canonical queue.

For source/queue changes, report `python scripts/check_method_intake.py` and retain pending-review warnings.
For added documents, update the root README index. Use `python scripts/repository_index.py --find TEXT` to locate existing paths before adding duplicates.
